title: The First Morning
sceneText:
There are already people in the courtyard when you come down.

Not many. Five or six, standing in different places, each of them doing something that looks like doing something. One is carrying things. One is waiting for the one carrying things to finish. They see you, and their movements do not stop, but the rhythm of them changes.

Martha leans out of the kitchen doorway with something still in her hands. She says nothing.

You realise they are waiting for you to speak first.

For three weeks nobody has told these people what to do. The wheat is in the fields, the tools are in the store, the ledger is on the desk upstairs. Everything is where it was, waiting for somebody to say the first sentence.

Today is the first of October. You have thirty days.
